properties.address: Southern Court, Newport Ind. Estate, Launceston, Cornwall PL15 8EX
properties.description: We cater from everyone and have toys for children, magazines, books and puzzles. Everyone welcome... bring along your craft projects, knitting and art materials. Enjoy free hot drinks, homemade soup, light lunches and afternoon cake.
